description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application demonstrating a reveal effect. It manages the main user interface, including fragment transactions, menu handling, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is an activity class that manages the main user interface including fragment management, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the RevealEffectBasicFragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and title based on the current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling the log view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging framework, wrapping Android's native log and configuring log display via a fragment.
